lame.min.js is lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs, npm "lamejs"), unmodified: a JavaScript port of
LAME (https://lame.sourceforge.io), licensed under the GNU LGPL 3.0. The upload page (/voices/studio) loads it as
a separate file to turn .wav and .flac recordings into .mp3 in the browser before upload.
